title: Units and zero divisors of ℤ₁₂
caption: Of the 12 residues, 0 is the zero, 4 are units (1, 5, 7, 11, those coprime to 12) and the other 7 (2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10) are zero divisors, for example 3 × 4 = 0. Every non-zero element is one or the other.
alt: One bar of 12 equal units split into three parts: 1 for the zero, 4 for the units 1, 5, 7 and 11, and 7 for the zero divisors 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10.
description: The zero element 0 is one part.
The units, coprime to 12, are 1, 5, 7 and 11: four of them.
The remaining seven, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10, share a factor with 12, so each is a zero divisor.
